Raters were instructed to score passage-level coherence, sentence-level coherence, and fluency using 5-point Likert scales (and binary labels for sentence coherence).

For passage-level coherence, human raters assign a coherence score to each full-length text sample, on a 5-point Likert scale. For sentence-level coherence, human raters label each sentence in the text passage with 0 or 1, indicating whether the particular sentence is coherent with the proceeding context. Human raters also evaluate the language quality for a fluency score on a 5-point Likert scale.
